system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.15.1 - Aether Mastery. Detecting and resisting Aether, countering Nether-based spells of increasing level (Counter Nether I-True), Aether bolts/balls/arcs/walls, layered Aether Armor and eventual immunity, matter disruption, an aura that amplifies elemental attacks passing through it, and Aether Mastery itself letting the caster use any lower spell on the list every round. Special note from the source: Aether represents all elemental energies in their most positive form - theorized capable of creating or repairing almost anything with proper control, a feat only ever accomplished once, by the six Elemental Lords acting together; positive applications of Aether remain outside non-divine understanding. Fidelity notes: level 7 is intentionally blank in the source (no spell printed); level 17 (Aether Ball II)'s own description reads "As Aether Ball II, except the radius is 20'" - a self-reference in the source rather than referencing Aether Ball I - kept exactly as printed.
Caster is aware of any Elemental Aether in the area of effect as long as he concentrates.

Caster channels Elemental Aether energy at the target spell. This effect nullifies up to a 1st level class "E" Nether based spell. The caster must make a successful Targeting maneuver to counter spell the same round it is cast. If the spell is not cast directly at the caster, then the caster must spend an additional 20% action to monitor spell casting. The target spell receives no RR.

Target is protected from Elemental Aether, providing a +10 to the target's resistance rolls and defensive bonuses against Aether. This spell also provides a +5 bonus against all other elements except Nether.
An arc of Aether is shot from the caster's palm. Results are determined on the Aether Bolt Attack Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.
Creates an opaque wall of Aether (up to 10' x 10' x 6'). Anyone passing through takes an 'A' Aether critical (no RR).
As Counter Nether I, except it affects up to 5th level spells.
A bolt of Aether is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Aether Bolt Table.
As Counter Nether I, except it can effect up to 8th level spells.
A 1' diameter ball of Aether is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 10'R area. Resolve attack on the Aether Ball Table.
As Resist Aether, except bonus against Aether is +20 and +10 against all other elements.
As Aether Bolt I, except range is 300'.
As Counter Nether I, except it can effect up to 11th level spells.
As Wall of Aether, except "wall" is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

Caster directs a ray of Aether energy at target non-sentient material. Target material is separated into its base elements (e.g., if a block of stone is disrupted, then it would be separated into elemental earth, and any impurities within it, like water or air) up to 1 cu' per level.
As Counter Nether I, except it affects up to 15th level spells.
As Aether Ball II, except the radius is 20'.
As Aether Bolt I, except range is 500'.
As Aether Armor I, except the bonus is +20, target takes half damage and critical results are reduced one level in severity. Against all other elements it grants a +20 bonus.

Caster creates Aether energy within the radius that is non-damaging in nature. This energy will cling to and enhance all elemental attacks through the area. All elemental attacks originating within the radius or passing through the radius deliver double Concussion hit damage and gain a +10 to the attack roll.
As Counter Nether I, except it affects any level spell. The caster must spend a number of power points 10% higher than the level of the spell to be countered.

As Aether Armor I, except target is immune to all Aether-based attacks. Against all other elements (except Nether), the target gains a +20 to DB and RR, halves all hits and reduces critical severities by one.
Caster can use one lower level spell (on this list) each round.
